race.comment: SOUTHBY (4) has been plying his trade in Saturday metro grade of late and will find this assignment much more to his liking. Has a win and two seconds from four attempts over this staying journey and gets Rodd on top to navigate from the sticky draw. Will prove very hard to toss.TEWKESBURY (2) made up some steady ground when resuming last time out and will appreciate the extra trip here. Right in this contest. CIGAR MAN (1) got the job done at Toowoomba at the latest outing and winning rider Keeley retains the mount. Top-three candidate on that form. TRIPLE TIME (5) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be underestimated.
